AI & Automation

Master AI and Automation and unlock limitless career opportunities.

Learn to build smart systems, from chatbots to predictive models.

Enrol Now
Apply For Scholarship

Beginner Friendly

No prior experience required.

Job Placement Support

Launch your career with internships and job placements.

Flexible Learning

Choose to learn at a pace that fits your schedule.

World-Class Tutors & Mentorship

Learn directly from industry experts.

Certificate

Earn a recognised certificate.

Download Course Brochure & Curriculum

Course Overview

This course introduces students to Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Automation fundamentals, exploring how intelligent systems are built, trained, and deployed to solve real-world problems. You’ll learn how to use AI tools, automation frameworks, and no-code platforms to streamline workflows, build intelligent systems, and drive efficiency across industries.
Designed for beginners and professionals alike, this program blends theory, hands-on projects, and real business applications to help you gain the skills needed to thrive in the age of intelligent technology.

Learning Outcome

  1. Understand the core principles of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Automation.
  2. Build simple automation workflows using no-code and low-code tools such as Zapier, Make, N8N and ChatGPT API.
  3. Apply AI tools for business operations, marketing, analytics, and productivity enhancement.
  4. Design and deploy automation-driven solutions that improve efficiency and decision-making.

Next Cohort Starts
October 31st 2026

Duration: 3 months
Enrol Now
Apply For Scholarship

Career Opportunities

  1. United States – $85,000 – $120,000 USD
  2. United Kingdom – £50,000 – £75,000 GBP
  3. Canada – $70,000 – $95,000 CAD
  4. Germany – €55,000 – €80,000 EUR
  5. Nigeria – ₦5.5 million – ₦9 million NGN
  6. Kenya – KSh 2.2 million – KSh 3.8 million KES
  7. Remote/Global Roles – $60,000 – $100,000 USD

Career Pathways

  1. AI Automation Specialist
  2. Business Process Automation Consultant
  3. No-Code AI Developer
  4. AI Product Manager
  5. Intelligent Systems Analyst

What You Will Learn

Go from Idea to Impact, become a AI & Automation Engineer in 3-6 Months.

Module 1 - Introduction AI & Automation
  • What is AI?
  • What is Prompt Engineering?
  • What is Automation?
  • Types of Automation
  • Overview of Automation Platforms
  • Relationships & Advanced Data Structures
  • Examples & practice questions
Module 2 - AI Automation in Practice
  • Planning an Automation Project
  • Automation Best Practices
  • Workflow Design Principles
  • Common Automation Use Cases
Module 3 - Zapier & Smart Workflow Automation
  • Triggers, Actions, and Paths
  • Formatters and Delays
  • Webhooks
  • Code by Zapier
  • Integrating Google Workspace tools
Module 4 - Make & Advanced Workflow Automation
  • Introduction to Make and how it works
  • Scenarios, Modules, and Data Mapping
  • Triggers and Actions
  • Routers, Filters, and Logic
  • Webhooks and Custom Integrations
  • Data Stores and API Connections
  • Building Multi-App Workflows
  • Real-World Case Studies and Assignments
Module 5 - n8n Advanced Workflow Automation
  • Introduction to n8n and its interface
  • Understanding Nodes, Triggers, and Workflows
  • Building simple automations step by step
  • Using Logic Controls and Data Transformations
  • Webhooks and API Integrations
  • Error Handling and Execution Control
  • Practice: Create a 3-step automated workflow
Module 6 - Airtable Foundations & Data Management
  • Introduction to Airtable
  • Key parts: Bases, Tables, Records, Fields, and Views
  • Airtable vs. Traditional Spreadsheets
  • Overview of Field Types (text, number, date, attachment, dropdown, etc.)
  • Understanding Relationships between Tables
  • Basic Data Structures and Formulas
  • Hands-on: Create a client management database
  • Practice questions and exercises
Module 7 - Automations, Integrations & Collaboration
  • Overview of View Types: Grid, Form, Calendar, Gallery, Kanban
  • Filtering, Sorting, and Grouping data
  • Automations: Triggers, Actions, and Conditional Logic
  • Using Forms for data collection
  • Sharing, Collaboration, and Dashboards
  • Intro to Interface Designer
  • Connecting Airtable with Make or Zapier
  • Webhooks and Basic API setup
  • Case Studies: Real-world Airtable workflows
Module 8 - Chatbot Development & Implementation
  • Introduction to Chatbots
  • Chatbot Use Cases
  • Chatbot Building Platforms(Voiceflow, n8n, Chatbase, ManyChat)
  • Other Platforms
  • Advanced Chatbot Features
  • Exercise
Module 9 - AI Agents & Agentic Systems
  • Understanding AI Agents
  • Types of AI Agents
  • Low-Code/No-Code AI Agent Platforms(n8n, Relevance AI)
  • Code-First Agentic AI Frameworks(Langchain)
  • Multi-Agent Systems
  • AI Agent Capabilities
  • Real-World AI Agent Applications
  • Governance and Safety
  • Exercise 1: Design an AI agent workflow for a specific business task
  • Exercise 2: Build a simple AI agent using a no-code platform (n8n, Lindy, Flowise, or
    Voiceflow)
Module 10 - AI Agents & Smart Automation with n8n
  • Introduction to AI-powered automation
  • Connecting n8n with AI tools (OpenAI, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)
  • Using APIs to build AI Agents
  • Integrating tools like ManyChat, Voiceflow for conversational automation
  • Combining AI with data sources (Airtable, Google Sheets, etc.)
  • Automating tasks for lead generation, and customer support
  • Building multi-channel workflows across email, chat, and web forms
  • Case Study: Build a basic AI Agent workflow
  • Assignment: Create an AI-powered task automation
Module 11 - Vibe Coding & AI-Powered Development
  • Introduction to Vibe Coding
  • The Vibe Coding Philosophy
  • AI-Powered IDEs and Code Editors
  • No-Code/Low-Code AI Development Platforms(Bolt.new,
  • Vibe Coding Workflow
  • Challenges and Limitations
  • Exercise
Module 12 - AI Voice Agents & Conversational AI
  • Introduction to AI Voice Agents
  • Voice Agent Capabilities
  • Platforms for Building AI Voice Agents(Vapi, Retell AI)
  • Other Voice AI Platforms(ElevenLabs)
  • Voice Agent Use Cases
  • Best Practices for Voice AI Agent
  • Exercise
